answer.title: Automate Supplier Bill Entry from Email
answer.trigger: A new supplier invoice email is received from a vendor like DrainPro.
steps: Extract the invoice reference, amount, and due date using AI.
Create a new supplier bill draft in the accounts system.
Review the extracted details and bill draft for accuracy.
Approve and post the supplier bill into the accounts system.
answer.ai_help: Extracting invoice reference, amount, and due date details from the email body.
answer.human_approval: Emma reviews and approves the draft supplier bill before it is finally posted to the accounts system.
answer.risk_reason: Incorrect bill amounts or details could lead to accounting errors or overpayment to suppliers.
